sn14.36:1.2: Said also of aggregates ([sn22.30]()), and the senses ([sn35.21](), 22), this template gets its own Saṁyutta (SN 26). | The first phrase in this template consistently has four terms, the final two of which (_abhinibbatti_ and _pātubhāva_) are synonyms that appear together in the stock definition of “rebirth” ([sn12.2:4.2]()). The following phrase, however, only has three: arising (_uppāda_), continuing (_ṭhiti_), and manifesting (_pātubhāva_).
